subject: Simple class condition
notes: Rule: 'If the word NOT is specified, the truth value is reversed.' (cite.py --check 8.8.4.4.4 -> OK §8.8.4.4.4 2)). All three class-condition bound shapes render `c.Negated ? !(test) : (test)` over the GR1/GR3 test, so the reversal applies after the zero-length FALSE as the rule order requires. Probed: ZL NOT NUMERIC -> T, ZL NOT ALPHABETIC-UPPER -> T, AX(1:0) NOT HEXC -> T, READ '12A' NOT NUMERIC -> T, 'ABC' NOT ALPHABETIC -> F. pb590 case D asserts the NOT reversal derived from GR2; ca7_class_zero_length asserts it at zero length.
